name: CVP
label: Central venous pressure
description: Right atrial pressure; reflects venous volume status and right-heart preload.

name: PCWP
label: Pulmonary capillary wedge pressure
description: Left atrial pressure surrogate; left-heart preload and congestion indicator.

name: HIST
label: Patient history flag
description: Binary prior history flag; encodes baseline cardiac risk.

name: TPR
label: Total peripheral resistance
description: Systemic vascular resistance; afterload determinant.

name: BP
label: Blood pressure
description: Systemic arterial pressure; the principal haemodynamic alarm trigger.

name: CO
label: Cardiac output
description: Heart rate × stroke volume; central perfusion index.

name: HRBP
label: Heart rate / blood pressure index
description: Monitoring index; detects HR/BP dissociation patterns.

name: HREK
label: Heart rate from EKG
description: EKG-measured HR; noisy observation of true HR.

name: HRSA
label: Heart rate / oxygen saturation index
description: Monitoring index combining HR and SpO2; detects hypoxic tachycardia.

name: PAP
label: Pulmonary artery pressure
description: Pulmonary arterial pressure; elevated by PE or LVF.

name: SAO2
label: Arterial oxygen saturation
description: Arterial O2 saturation; key hypoxaemia alarm indicator.

name: FIO2
label: Fraction of inspired oxygen
description: Ventilator O2 setting; root determinant of oxygen delivery.

name: PRSS
label: Breathing circuit pressure
description: Observed circuit pressure; reflects tube-level ventilation.

name: ECO2
label: Expired CO2
description: End-tidal CO2; alveolar ventilation and metabolism indicator.

name: MINV
label: Minute ventilation (observed)
description: Measured minute ventilation; can deviate from machine output.

name: MVS
label: Minute ventilation set (target)
description: Clinician-set ventilation target; root of the ventilation delivery chain.

name: HYP
label: Hypovolemia
description: Reduced circulating blood volume; primary preload cause.

name: LVF
label: Left ventricular failure
description: Impaired LV contractility; raises filling pressures and reduces output.

name: APL
label: Anaphylaxis
description: Severe systemic allergic reaction; causes acute vasodilation.

name: ANES
label: Insufficient anesthesia / analgesia
description: Pain/awareness under anaesthesia; triggers sympathetic activation.

name: PMB
label: Pulmonary embolus
description: Pulmonary vascular obstruction; raises PAP and creates V/Q mismatch.

name: INT
label: Intubation status
description: ETT placement; determines whether ventilation reaches the trachea/lungs.

name: KINK
label: Kinked breathing tube
description: ETT kinking; obstructs gas flow and reduces VTUB.

name: DISC
label: Circuit disconnection
description: Breathing circuit separation; eliminates all gas delivery.

name: LVV
label: Left ventricular end-diastolic volume
description: LV preload; the Frank-Starling determinant of stroke volume.

name: STKV
label: Stroke volume
description: Volume ejected per heartbeat; central output integrator.

name: CCHL
label: Catecholamine level
description: Circulating catecholamines; drives HR and vasoconstriction.

name: ERLO
label: Error / low output flag
description: Low-output alarm; triggers catecholamine reflex and clinical alert.

name: HR
label: Heart rate
description: Heart rate; rate component of cardiac output.

name: ERCA
label: Electrocautery in use
description: Surgical electrocautery active; corrupts EKG measurement.

name: SHNT
label: Intrapulmonary shunt
description: Fraction of CO bypassing ventilated alveoli; causes O2-refractory hypoxaemia.

name: PVS
label: Pulmonary venous oxygen saturation
description: O2 saturation of blood leaving the lungs; set by FIO2 and alveolar ventilation.

name: ACO2
label: Arterial CO2
description: PaCO2; inversely proportional to alveolar ventilation.

name: VALV
label: Alveolar ventilation
description: Effective gas-exchange ventilation; lung ventilation minus dead space.

name: VLNG
label: Lung ventilation
description: Total ventilation reaching the lungs; penultimate ventilation delivery node.

name: VTUB
label: Tube ventilation
description: Gas flow at the ETT; subject to mechanical circuit faults.

name: VMCH
label: Ventilator machine output
description: Mechanical ventilator gas delivery; set by MVS.
